messages:
Aria: quick heads-up — Kira from DeepSight wants a POC that reserves 4xA100 equivalent but wants the commit split across two pools: 2x high-priority low-latency pool + 2x cheap-spot-style pool with autoscale and a burst fallback to hosted. they asked if we can offer a blended rate or a special tier for the POC.
Matt: thanks — what's the ask on duration/commit? POC length changes pricing a lot.
Kira: 8 weeks POC, likely ramp to 6k token instances/day. goal is low-latency inference for 2 models during peak, but they accept lower perf on non-peak. want to test autoscale and bursting to hosted if their private pool is saturated.
Aria: ok. thinking: offer a provisional commit with a 60/40 effective split pricing. we treat reserved for the 2 high-priority GPUs at standard dedicated rate, and the 2 flexible GPUs at a reduced commit rate but with burst charges to hosted at published burst rates if used. Need deal desk approval for blended.
Vikram: technically fine. runtime supports routing policy: prefer dedicated-high, then dedicated-flex, then hosted. autoscale policy can cap burst QPS to avoid runaway costs. add KV cache warmup to reduce burst volume.
Matt: can we quantify costs? rough numbers will help revops approve.
Emma: if base dedicated rate = $X/hr per A100-equivalent and hosted burst = $Y/hr, then blended monthly commit = (2*X + 2*X*0.6) * hours less expected burst. for a short POC we can give a 15% POC discount on the flexible pool portion only. need final numbers to submit to deal desk.
Aria: propose a simple table for Kira: 2x reserved performance pool @ full commit rate; 2x flexible pool @ 60% commit rate + 15% discount; burst to hosted billed at standard burst multiplier. attach sample clause for contract.
Matt: share the clause here pls.
Aria: ```
POC_COMMIT: Customer commits to 2 dedicated high-priority units and 2 flexible units for 8 weeks. Flexible units billed at 60% committed utilization; burst to Redwood hosted will be charged at published on-demand burst rates. Redwood will enforce autoscale caps and routing fallback to ensure predictability. Any usage beyond agreed caps will be invoiced at burst rates and subject to review.
```
Vikram: one operational note — we should enable a burst cap per customer and per-minute rate limiting. also enable prefix caching for the high-priority models to cut token counts by ~20% during the POC.
Emma: sending to deal desk — need final dollar numbers and a short risk note. ccing finance for provisional billing flow.
DealBot: deal desk request created: DD-5821. status: pending review. approver: @emma
Matt: Kira, can you confirm acceptable upper bound for hosted burst in USD for the POC? we need that to model risk.
Kira: can cap hosted burst to $1,200/week. if we hit that we will pause bursts and notify your team.
Emma: perfect. i'll model with that cap. i'll request provisional approval for: blended pricing + 15% discount on flexible pool for 8 weeks, burst cap $1,200/week, and autoscale caps as specified. will ping procurement for contract addendum.
Aria: thanks all. once deal desk approves, solutions will post the POC runbook and runtime team will enable routing and caps. :thumbsup:
Matt: noted — I'll prep the runbook and a quick dashboard for live burst spend tracking.
Kira: thanks team — excited to run this tomorrow. :rocket:
